_readme: The single ledger for everything Talaash Heritage and archaeologywala make: posts, reels, 3D models, lectures, web pages. Every piece gets one id here before it is built, and its status is updated when it goes live. Series numbers are taken only from this ledger: run tools/check_universe.py and use the 'next' number it prints, then add the item here before building it. Rules: docs/UNIVERSE.md. Check with python3 tools/check_universe.py before every commit that touches this file. Talaash tasks write here; archaeologywala tasks read it and log in their run book, and the Sunday universe review copies their live posts in.

ancient-india-3d.name: Ancient India in 3D
ancient-india-3d.format: 3D reel or diorama carousel, Collab with talaashheritage
ancient-india-3d.note: archaeologywala's own 3D series, distinct from Jaisa Tha. #1 = 17 Nov burials reel; #2 = Harappan diorama carousel.

3d-model.name: Interactive 3D models
3d-model.note: Free to view on the Talaash site; each one later becomes a Jaisa Tha episode.

deep-dive.name: Deep Dive
deep-dive.format: weekly: blog on archaeologywala.pages.dev/deep-dive/ + narrated slide video (YouTube on the Talaash channel, playlist 'archaeologywala Deep Dive', and on the blog) + IG launch reel (Thu) + IG notes carousel (Tue) + YouTube Short + link posts on Talaash LinkedIn and Facebook
deep-dive.note: Set up 12 Nov 2026 (Pryank: one rare, scholarly topic a week, every platform cross-linked). Every Thursday from 26 Nov 2026. Rules: claude/deep-dive.md in the archaeologywala project. One topic per Deep Dive; its topic_lock covers both accounts for 30 days.
